subject: Social Media
title: Envy Goes Digital
description: A micro-lesson that makes Envy Goes Digital usable.

hook.text: A study gave people $100. They were happy until told their neighbor got $200. Social media is that study.

buildup.text: Envy is the pain of another's advantage. Social media put that pain on an infinite, 24-hour feed.

discovery.text: Benign envy motivates: 'I want what they have.' Malicious envy destroys: 'I want them to lose it.'

twist.text: Research shows social media triggers mostly malicious envy. You don't think 'I'll work harder.' You think 'It's unfair.'

climax.text: Germany calls it 'Schadenfreude feeds'—social media designed to make others' failures your entertainment.

punchline.text: Envy online is envy without limits.

quiz.question: What type of envy does social media mostly trigger?
